rec.name: Contact Form Section with Optional Image
rec.status: First attempt — code delivered, no screenshots or test results

what.text: A fully styleable contact form section for the Shopify theme editor. It has a heading, Name, Email and Message fields, an optional Phone field, and a submit button. An optional image sits beside the form, on the left or right, and stacks below the form on mobile. It uses Shopify's native contact form, including the success message and error output.

why.text: A clear, low-friction contact path reduces uncertainty before purchase. Shoppers with open questions about shipping, sizing or returns can ask instead of abandoning. An approachable form with a friendly image and a visible, on-brand button signals that real people are reachable, which builds trust. Keeping the required fields to email and message minimizes effort. This is an inference: the ticket states no rationale.

how.text: Add the code as a new section file (e.g. cro-contact.liquid). Add it to the contact page template, or to any page via the theme editor. In the editor, set the background, text alignment, optional image and image position, heading text, font, size and color, label styling, input styling, button text, font, size, colors and style (normal, rounded or pill), and whether the phone field shows. The form uses {% form 'contact' %}, so submissions arrive in Shopify's standard customer-message flow. Success and error messages use the theme's translation keys (contact.form.*). On screens up to 768px the layout stacks into one column.

items: Image (image picker) and image position (left or right)
Heading text (default 'Kontaktieren Sie uns'), font, size 16–60px, color
Input font, background color, text color
Button text (default 'Nachricht senden'), font, size 12–30px, background, text color, style (normal, rounded, pill)
Show or hide the phone number field (on by default)

dependencies.text: No metafields or apps are needed; it uses Shopify's native contact form. The theme must provide the translation keys contact.form.name, email, message, phone and post_success, plus the CSS variables --border-color and --success-color (with fallbacks if absent). Code-quality notes, inferred from reading the code: the schema defines no heading_style, label_style or input_style settings, though the markup references them. The font_picker values heading_font and label_font are output as CSS classes, which won't apply a font; they need font_face or font_family styles like the input and button fields use. The email field has autocomplete="off", which hurts UX and could be removed. img_url is deprecated in favor of image_url. Schema labels and defaults are in German and need translating or localizing per store.

items: Contact page visit to submission conversion
Support-driven assisted conversions (orders from users who contacted)
Reduction in pre-purchase support emails or chats elsewhere
Bounce rate and exit rate on the contact page
